analysis: 这更像模型路线信号，重点不在这次功能本身，而在后续资源和能力会往哪里倾斜。模型团队每次公开表态，其实都在提前给生态做预告。

name: Zara Zhang
role: Builder. Dangerously skips permissions. Harvard’17. GitHub: https://github.com/zarazhangrui YouTube: https://youtube.com/@ZaraZhangg
summary: Before shipping a product built with AI, the most important step is to think about what features you can CUT, not what features you can add
summaryEn: Before shipping a product built with AI, the most important step is to think about what features you can CUT, not what features you can add
analysis: 这类动态背后真正的新意，是界面开始围着任务生成，而不是让用户去适应固定页面。谁先把生成式 UI 接进真实数据，谁就更可能重写体验上限。

name: Aditya Agarwal
role: General Partner @SouthPkCommons , Co-Founder @Bevel_Health | Ex: Early Eng @facebook , CTO @Dropbox , Board @Flipkart | Optimist, Builder, Dad
analysis: 如果生成式 UI 成为常态，未来不少产品的优势都会来自更顺滑的任务组织方式。届时 UI 本身会成为智能系统的一部分，而不是最后一层壳。

name: OpenAI
role: OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We’re hiring: http://openai.com/jobs
summary: Introducing the OpenAI Safety Fellowship, a new program supporting independent research on AI safety and alignment—and the next generation of talent.
summaryEn: Introducing the OpenAI Safety Fellowship, a new program supporting independent research on AI safety and alignment—and the next generation of talent.
analysis: 重点不在论文标题，而在它最后能不能沉淀成开发者真正能调用、用户真正能感知的新能力。研究只有进入工具链，才会变成产业变量。

name: 今日总结
role: Builder Daily
summary: 今天共追踪到 21 位 builder 的 36 条动态。Agent 正从 demo 走向真实工作流；模型厂商持续向外释放路线信号；内容、社群和分发继续绑定；整体看，竞争重点正从单点模型能力，转向工作流整合、分发效率和更快的商业化闭环。
